description: In-band Data Loss Prevention (DLP) engine. Redacts SSNs, credit cards, emails, phone numbers, AWS keys, OpenAI/Anthropic tokens, and JWTs from text or JSON data before LLM ingestion (GDPR Article 5 & EU AI Act compliant).

mask_emails.description: Whether to redact email addresses (default: true).

payload.description: The raw text, database dump, or JSON string to sanitize.

name: redact_pii_dlp
